summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its wholly owned subsidiary, Boca International Limited, submitted two competitive tender proposals to Nan Fung Property Management Limited in Hong Kong. The proposals cover chiller replacement works at MOS Centre, valued at HKD 7,000,000, and air-conditioning retrofit with an energy-saving sharing scheme plus O&M at Nan Fung Centre, valued at HKD 60,000,000. No board recommendation, advisor, securities terms, or special-situation event is disclosed; this is ordinary course business activity.
